summary: The diff shows frontend changes for staff management with Principal ID validation and serial number display, plus admin access control in the dashboard. However, critical backend logic for automatic serial number generation/updates and authentication-based access control is missing or not visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Authenticated owner has permissions to add new entries and unauthenticated users cannot access entry management features
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows isAdmin checks in the UI (DashboardLayout.tsx) but no evidence of backend enforcement preventing unauthenticated API calls to add/edit/remove staff

missing_requirements.requirement: When a Principal ID is updated, the system automatically generates or updates the corresponding Serial Number
missing_requirements.reason: No backend logic visible for automatic serial number generation when Principal ID changes. The formatSerialNumber function in StaffManagement.tsx only formats existing Principal IDs for display, but does not show generation or persistence of separate serial numbers

missing_requirements.requirement: Serial Number changes are persisted to backend storage
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of backend storage changes or API modifications to handle serial number persistence. The diff shows only frontend formatting of Principal IDs

missing_requirements.requirement: Serial Number update happens atomically with Principal ID modification
missing_requirements.reason: No backend transaction logic visible to ensure atomic updates of both Principal ID and Serial Number together

hallucinated_features.description: Serial number formatting from Principal ID (formatSerialNumber function)
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest indicates Serial Numbers should be automatically generated/updated when Principal IDs change, implying separate storage. The implementation merely formats the Principal ID for display rather than managing separate serial numbers
